unmet_target: Northern strong bows, overall curvature and broad trailing stratiform echo are not consistently corrected. Southern links improve but not all seeds/times are fragment-free. No claim all requested morphology is fixed.
method: Matched native Astra 12 km / 14 levels and Sol 28 km, 10 h. Actual unmodified radar; fixed 6--9 h window, 15-minute connectivity and hourly morphology. All samples retained, no radar dilation or synthesized bridges.
changes: warm-donor existence no longer vetoed by RKW balance before actual mechanical displacement is tested; signed shear work and actual positive inflow still required by their separate closures

14-km stochastic cloud clusters, 34-km broad-mode removal, unit mean
finite seeded initiating confluence half-length 200--240 km, not prescribed radar length
mature closure requirement capped at prior 190-km footprint calibration to avoid rear anchoring
mother confluence closure recognizes segmented mature heads sharing actual cold air
new convective ice rearflow uses actual warm donor energy and unretained cloud shear for initial direction
unrimed detrainment enters transported ice before aggregation; temperature-dependent ice sticking
smooth initial middle-tropospheric humidity calibration, finite initial water and seeded moisture retained
Sol extra subgrid initiation lift requires actual available CAPE >150 J/kg
not_changed: cold-air mass transport, recovery and neutral retirement
real inflow and signed RKW shear gates
finite donor air/water and CAPE debt
default grids, levels, duration, UI controls
limitations: Not a resolved 3-D MCS or radar-assimilated forecast.
12-km cells cannot verify 10--30 km bow details; no default 6-km/72-hour test is claimed.
A connected-component fraction can rise when a secondary segment weakens; inspect actual images, size and span together.
Weak-echo area is 10--35 dBZ within 150 km west of the main active 35-dBZ head, in its occupied rows. It is not the thermal cold-pool area or tracked stratiform storm identity.
No claim that every seed remains a single straight line or that mountains and sea never split it.
